notes: The DAAD page states tuition fees of 9,201 EUR per semester for non-EU applicants, while the CBS page states 1,500 EUR per semester for non-EU students; the CBS page was used because it is the programme's own page, but the discrepancy should be verified. The application deadline of 30 April has no stated year; the pages refer to the 2027/2028 winter semester with the portal reopening in December. The application channel is not clearly stated for foreign-diploma applicants; the pages mention a KIT online application portal and a KIT Application Portal, but no uni-assist or direct route sentence specific to this programme was found.

evidence.quote: Otherwise applicants are required to provide proof of sufficient English language skills corresponding to at least level B2 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) or equivalent.

Only the following internationally recognized tests are accepted: TOEFL IELTS CAE (University of Cambridge Certificate in Advanced English) CPE (University of Cambridge Certificate of Proficiency in English) UNIcert 90 iBT Band score of 6.5 (and no section lower than 5.5) Level II or better

note.en: Check whether the Moroccan diploma is recognized via uni-assist (VPD) and the DAAD database; provide transcripts of the last three school years.

evidence.quote: To check if your secondary school certificate makes you eligible to study in Germany, please consult the DAAD database on admission requirements.
